Per ref 08, CO-4/N822 = returned unprocessable; remedy is a new original claim (CLM05-3=1), not a corrected 7.

root_cause.explanation: All 5 lines denied CO-4/N822. 837P sent KX but omitted GP on every line (97530×2, 97140×2, 97116). Chart note is a PT session; GP is required on all always-therapy CPTs under a PT plan of care.

next_action.detail: Append GP to every service line (97530, 97140, 97116). Resubmit as a NEW original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8) — Medicare Part B does not accept frequency 7. File before the 1-year DOS deadline (2027-06-05). The returned claim never stopped the filing clock.
